 News › News News › CBSE Practical Exam Date Sheet 2027: Class 10, 12 schedule announced for winter-bound schools; check… CBSE Practical Exam Date Sheet 2027: Class 10, 12 schedule announced for winter-bound schools; check complete dates
 Adhya Sarna Updated: Nov 6, 2026, 07:34 IST CBSE Practical Exam Date Sheet 2027 The Central Board of Secondary Education ( CBSE ) has announced the schedule for Class 10 and Class 12 practical examinations, project assessments and internal assessments for the 2026-27 academic session. The exercise will be conducted in winter-bound schools from November 9 to December 19, 2026.
 The board has clarified that the present schedule and accompanying instructions apply only to winter-bound schools, which follow an academic calendar adapted to harsh winter conditions. Schools following the regular academic session will not be covered by this notice. For them, CBSE has stated that a separate circular will be issued in due course. Practical examinations for Class 12 students in such schools are expected to be conducted in January.
 In its notice, CBSE directed schools to prepare the final list of candidates and ensure that only those students whose names have been submitted through the online List of Candidates (LOC) are permitted to appear for the practical examinations, project assessments and internal assessments. The measure is intended to maintain accuracy in records and prevent discrepancies at the stage of marks submission.
 External examiners and observers 
 Schools requiring external examiners or observers have been asked to contact their respective CBSE regional offices for appointments. 
 The board has thus retained the external oversight mechanism in the conduct of practical assessments, wherever applicable.
 Internal assessment for Class 10 
 The board has specified that the internal assessment for Class 10 will be conducted only once. Schools are required to complete the assessment and upload the marks for all candidates within the stipulated timeline. Institutions have been advised to adhere strictly to the deadlines, as delays may affect the processing of results.
 To ensure uniformity and fairness in the assessment process, CBSE has instructed schools to hold practical examinations and project assessments in two or three sessions a day if the number of students exceeds 30. The number of sessions will depend on the laboratory infrastructure available at the school. This provision seeks to ensure that students receive adequate time and resources during practicals, and that laboratories are not overcrowded.
 Mandatory photograph uploads 
 CBSE has also made it mandatory for schools to upload photographs of the practical examinations and assessments. The board will provide an app link through which schools must upload one group photograph of each batch appearing for the practical examination. The requirement is aimed at strengthening transparency and documentation of the assessment process.
 Particulars Instructions issued by CBSE 
 Practical examination dates November 9 to December 19, 2026 
 Applicable schools Winter-bound schools 
 External examiners and observers Schools to contact regional offices, wherever required 
 Photograph submission One group photograph per batch via CBSE app link 
 Regular-session schools Separate circular to be issued 
 The announcement comes as students and schools await the main examination date sheet for Class 10 and Class 12, which is expected to be released soon. Schools have been urged to follow the board's instructions carefully and to monitor official CBSE communications for further updates, particularly those following the regular academic session, who should await the separate circular before planning their practical assessments.
